objective: Correct dependency acceptance so a dependency passes only when its Issue is closed by a genuinely merged pull request, using GitHub data that is actually present in gh CLI responses.

assertions: A closed dependency Issue with at least one linked PR whose live PR data reports a non-null mergedAt is accepted.
A closed dependency Issue linked only to an open or closed-unmerged PR is rejected.
An open dependency Issue is rejected even if a malformed or unrelated PR reference is present.
Regression tests model the actual gh issue view response in which closedByPullRequestsReferences provides PR numbers and URLs but not nested mergedAt.
All GitHub lookups remain read-only and lookup or schema failures produce an explicit protocol error rather than a false acceptance.

deliverables: Deterministic unit regressions for merged, closed-unmerged, open, and lookup-failure cases
Short evidence note describing the observed gh CLI response boundary
risks: Additional per-dependency PR lookups can increase validation latency.
Relying on undocumented nested gh JSON fields can recreate the false rejection.
A permissive fallback on API failure could falsely accept unresolved dependencies.
notes: The bug was confirmed against Issue #1 and merged PR #8: gh issue view emitted only id/number/repository/url for closedByPullRequestsReferences, while GraphQL showed merged=true and mergedAt.
